# Requires **[PDML](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59255)**

~~why no pak? logic mod loader is kil~~ nevermind

# Legacy UE4SS Instructions:

# Requires [PD3 UE4SS V3.01 + Allow Pak Mods (BETA)](https://modworkshop.net/mod/47771)

> **Default configuration**: Menu + Heists both **ON**, Max Saturation **OFF**.
* Variants can be toggled through CFG_MENU, CFG_HEISTS and CFG_MAX_SATURATION in main.lua
* Press **F5** in-game to toggle on/off. Newly reworked heists (like Touch the Sky or Cook Off) get almost no change
-----
To install, place the folder in PAYDAY3\Binaries\Win64\UE4SS\Mods:
![](https://i.imgur.com/GnF0jzT.png)

data.name: Shade Voice Restoration
data.desc:
## A page focusing on restoring unused/cut/removed shade lines from combat to mission lines

### can display subs if using [Miscellaneous Text fixes](https://modworkshop.net/mod/54030?tab=downloads)

These are all separated so you can have the decision to reenable as many you want.

This was in Miscellanous Text Fixes before but i move it to this mod page for future implementations/additions

Holds the following at the moment

!!!

Taser Incoming - Shade can call out when Tasers can spawn

Cloaker Incoming - Shade can call out when Cloakers can spawn

Sabotage Squad Incoming - Shade can call out when they are going to sabotage the objective

Nader Incoming - Shade can call out when Naders can spawn

Hostage Rescue Incoming- Shade can call out when Hostage rescue team is going for civvies

Assault Incoming - Shade calls out assault incoming phase

!!!

More to come

- Civilian Death Warnings - Shade calls out when a player kills a civillian (only works 100% in Solo Mode/if Host and client has the mod)

- Final Assault Reminder

- Various Mission VO from briefings to In game

and others maybe

data.name: REDCORE ASSAULT RIFLES SKIN PACK MODS
data.desc:
# REDCORE ASSAULT RIFLES PACK MODS

Seven rifles. Seven different styles. One collection.

Give your PAYDAY 3 arsenal a fresh look with **REDCORE**, a collection of seven custom weapon skins. From black-and-gold finishes and traditional Thai ornamentation to neon accents, purple lightning and pastel hearts, each rifle brings something different to your loadout.

Showcase :
![](https://https://youtu.be/m2WlurgfFaI?si=F5bOS2IXQlVlOR4I)


**Included skins**

| Weapon | Skin |
|---|---|
| VF-7S | Gold Dragon |
| Skogskrigare AG-9 | Violet Reaper |
| CAR-4 | Thai Royal Kranok |
| Chanit S3 | Red Circuit Star |
| KU-59 | Neon 23:59 |
| Northwest B-9 | Emerald Fracture |
| Adelig RG5 | Pastel Heart |

## Installation — PC / Loose PAK Version

1. Close PAYDAY 3.
2. Download the pack and extract the archive.
3. Open the game’s installation folder through your launcher.
4. Navigate to the location below and create a folder named **`~mods`** if it does not exist.

| Platform | Mod folder |
|---|---|
| Steam / Epic Games | `<GameFolder>\PAYDAY3\Content\Paks\~mods` |
| Xbox App / Microsoft Store on PC | `<GameFolder>\Content\PAYDAY3\Content\Paks\~mods` |

*`<GameFolder>` is the installation folder opened by your launcher.*

5. Copy the included **`.pak` files** directly into `~mods`. If matching `.utoc` or `.ucas` files are supplied, copy those alongside them.
6. Launch the game and equip the corresponding weapons.

**Current UE5 builds load loose PAK mods without UE4SS, Allow Pak Mods, or the `-fileopenlog` launch option.**

## Compatibility and Notes

- Remove older versions of these skins before installing an update.
- Other mods that replace the same weapon textures may conflict with this pack.
- Preview images are model or concept renders. In-game appearance may vary with lighting, attachments and graphics settings.
- Game updates may affect compatibility.

## Uninstallation

Close the game and remove this pack’s files from the `~mods` folder.

## Bug Reports

Found a texture issue? Include the weapon name, a screenshot, your game version and any other weapon skin mods you have installed.
